main.summary: Provides shared file-system helpers for append-oriented stream transfer staging storage operations.

method.name: CreateSessionStorageKey
method.summary: Create the normalized directory key used to store a stream transfer session on disk.
method.returns: Normalized storage key for the session.

method.name: GetStorageDirectoryPath
method.summary: Resolve the absolute staging directory path for a storage key under the configured root.
method.returns: Absolute directory path for the staged session.

method.name: SaveManifestAsync
method.summary: Persist a stream transfer manifest payload to the conventional manifest path.

method.name: ReadAllBytesSafeAsync
method.summary: Read a file payload if it exists and return null when the file is absent or a read error occurs.
method.param: Log message template to use on failure.

method.name: OpenStream
method.summary: Open a file stream configured for append-oriented staged stream transfer operations.

method.name: OpenRangeReadStream
method.summary: Open a bounded read-only stream over a realized appended range.
method.returns: A bounded read-only stream for the requested range.

method.name: PrepareAppendStreamFile
method.summary: Create or open the staged stream file and ensure it is at least the declared appended length.
method.returns: True when the staged stream file is prepared successfully.

method.name: WritePayloadAsync
method.summary: Copy exactly the expected number of bytes from a payload stream into the staged file stream.
method.param: Opened staged stream file positioned at the destination offset.
Readable payload stream positioned at the first byte to write.
Number of bytes that must be copied from the payload stream.
method.returns: True when the requested number of bytes is copied successfully.
